newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank to sell life insurance for China's PICC Life.
newsitem.headline: Bank to sell life insurance for China's PICC Life.

text.p: The Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the country's largest state bank, has agreed to act as agent for the People's Insurance (Life) Co Ltd of China (PICC Life), the China Daily said on Tuesday.

Under two agreements signed on Monday, the bank would handle life insurance premium collection and deduction as well as commissions to individual agents for PICC Life, China's leading domestic life insurer, the official newspaper said.
It gave no financial details of the agreements.
PICC Life, which reported a premium income of 21.2 billion yuan for 1995, would use the bank's 30,000 affiliates, workforce and settlement infrastructure, it said.
ICBC expected the insurance operations to spur an increase in bank deposits, the newspaper said but did not elaborate.

China had more than 200,000 individual insurance agents in both life and non-life sectors, it said, adding they dealt with nearly half of China's total premium income which totalled about 60.1 billion yuan in 1995.
China had 10 insurance companies dealing in life insurance, the newspaper said.
